## AC bookkeeping — the "If HONORED" branch is N/A, not done

Ticking that box for the close gate, so recording plainly what it means: **the HONORED branch
was NOT implemented, because the operator ruled REMOVE.** AC #2 and AC #3 are mutually
exclusive alternatives, and only one can be true. No structural-metric gating was added and no
`enabled=False` / `enabled=True` test exists — that work is deliberately not done, and there is
no changelog entry for a default behavior change because there is no behavior change.

The box is checked only because the close gate requires every AC item checked and offers no
"not applicable" state for an alternative branch. Read it as N/A, not as completed.

AC #3 (REMOVED) is the branch that was actually satisfied.
